# SaveAMedia — Comprehensive Knowledge Base & Technical Documentation (llms-full.txt)

> Domain: https://saveamedia.com
> Last Updated: 2026-11-11
> Application: SaveAMedia Instagram Reel Downloader & Media Extractor

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Brand Identity

SaveAMedia is a high-speed, web-based utility engineered to extract, preview, and download publicly available Instagram Reels, short-form videos, and audio tracks. Designed with a mobile-first philosophy, the platform delivers instant link-based video parsing with zero software installation, zero account registration, and zero watermark overlays.

Key Architectural Differentiators:
1. **Client-Side Sanitation**: Strips tracking tags (`?igsh=`, `?utm_source=`, `?fbclid=`) before network dispatch, safeguarding user identity.
2. **True 1080p Discovery**: Discovers uncompressed progressive MP4 master renditions directly from public Content Delivery Networks.
3. **In-Browser HTML5 Player**: Stream and verify video resolution and audio track synchronization before downloading.
4. **Standalone MP3 Audio Extraction**: Separates AAC stereo audio tracks and converts them into high-fidelity 320 kbps MP3 files.
5. **Redundant Edge Gateway**: Multi-server failover ensuring consistent service availability, with a client-side JavaScript bookmarklet alternative.

---

## 2. Supported Formats, Codecs & Renditions

| Format Label | Resolution | Aspect Ratio | Video Codec | Audio Bitrate | Container | Ideal Use Case |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1080p Full HD** | 1080 × 1920 | 9:16 vertical | H.264 / HEVC | 256 kbps AAC | `.mp4` | High-res displays, desktop viewing, offline archival |
| **720p HD** | 720 × 1280 | 9:16 vertical | H.264 (AVC) | 128 kbps AAC | `.mp4` | Standard mobile screens, bandwidth-conserving downloads |
| **480p SD** | 480 × 854 | 9:16 vertical | H.264 (AVC) | 96 kbps AAC | `.mp4` | Low-bandwidth networks, quick reference |
| **Audio Only (MP3)** | N/A | Audio | None | 320 kbps MP3 | `.mp3` | Music extraction, podcast sound bites, voiceovers |

## 3. Step-by-Step Device Guides

### How to Download on iPhone (iOS 13+):
1. Open the Instagram app and find the public Reel.
2. Tap the paper airplane (Share) icon and select **Copy link**.
3. Open Safari and navigate to `https://saveamedia.com`.
4. Paste the URL into the input card and tap **Download Reel**.
5. Once extracted, preview the video and tap **Download 1080p**.
6. When Safari prompts "Do you want to download...?", tap **Download**.
7. In Safari, tap the downward arrow in the address bar > tap the video file > tap the iOS Share icon > select **Save Video** to transfer it directly into your **Photos / Camera Roll**.

### How to Download on Android:
1. Open the Instagram app and tap Share > **Copy link** on any public Reel.
2. Open Google Chrome, Samsung Internet, or Firefox and go to `https://saveamedia.com`.
3. Paste the URL into SaveAMedia and tap **Download Reel**.
4. Tap **Download 1080p** or **Download MP3**.
5. The file saves directly to `/storage/emulated/0/Download/` and is immediately visible in Google Photos or Samsung Gallery.

### How to Download on Desktop (PC / Mac):
1. Open any web browser (Chrome, Safari, Edge, Firefox).
2. Copy the URL from the browser address bar (e.g., `https://www.instagram.com/reel/C29abcdefgh/`).
3. Paste into `https://saveamedia.com` and click **Download Reel**.
4. Choose 1080p MP4 or MP3 Audio. The file downloads directly to your PC or Mac Downloads folder.

---

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Is SaveAMedia safe and free?
Yes. SaveAMedia is completely free with no subscriptions or accounts required. Because it runs purely in your web browser, it never requests or stores your Instagram username, password, or security credentials.

### Does SaveAMedia download private Instagram Reels?
No. SaveAMedia strictly complies with creator privacy and platform security protocols. Only publicly accessible Instagram Reels that you have the right or permission to download can be extracted.

### Does SaveAMedia add watermarks?
No. SaveAMedia delivers the unaltered original video stream without adding any logos, branding, or watermarks.

### What is the client-side Bookmarklet?
The SaveAMedia Bookmarklet is a single-click desktop browser button:
`javascript:(function(){var u=window.location.href;if(u.indexOf('instagram.com')!==-1){window.open('https://saveamedia.com/?url='+encodeURIComponent(u),'_blank');}else{alert('Please open an Instagram Reel page first.');}})();`
Dragging this to your browser bookmarks bar allows you to download any Instagram Reel with a single click.

## 5. Legal, Privacy, Google AdSense & Regulatory Compliance

- **Google AdSense DART Cookies:** Third-party advertising vendors (including Google) utilize DART cookies to serve interest-based ads. Users can opt out via https://adssettings.google.com and https://www.aboutads.info/choices.
- **GDPR & CCPA Rights:** Users can request access, rectification, or erasure under GDPR (Regulation EU 2016/679) and CCPA/CPRA. SaveAMedia never sells personal information.
- **DMCA Agent Notice:** In compliance with 17 U.S.C. § 512(c), designated copyright agent contact: dmca@saveamedia.com / support@saveamedia.com.
- **Nominative Fair Use:** Instagram is a trademark of Meta Platforms, Inc. SaveAMedia is not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta Platforms, Inc.
